title: [finding] Both guard-main-checkout hooks' remediation text teaches a doubly-hazardous worktree recipe — no `--no-track` AND based on unfetched local `main`
body:
Found while reviewing ui PR #6976 (the objectui `--no-track` hardening): the ui dev measured objectui's hooks carrying the unhardened recipe in their remediation text; this seat re-measured the objectstack twins and they are WORSE.

## Measured, at origin/main `09b0d7b95`+

`.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.sh:57` and `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.sh:548` both print, as the remediation an agent reads at the exact moment it is blocked:

```
git worktree add ../${name}-<task> -b <branch> main
```

Two hazards in one line, both already adjudicated elsewhere in this repo's own instruction text:

1. **No `--no-track`** — plain `-b` writes `branch.NAME.remote`/`branch.NAME.merge` into the shared `.git/config` (the #13052/ui#6880 class; AGENTS.md's prescribed recipe was hardened, the hooks' copy was not).
2. **Based on local `main`, not `origin/main`** — an unfetched local `main` bases the new worktree on a stale tree (the ui#6208 class, fixed in the prescribed recipes of both repos, surviving here).

The remediation text is the HIGHEST-leverage copy of the recipe: it is delivered precisely when an agent is about to create a worktree, and an agent following the hook's own advice lands on a stale base with a shared-config write. `grep -c "no-track"` over both hooks: 0.

## Scope when dispatched

Both hook files: align the remediation string to the prescribed form (`git fetch origin main && git worktree add --no-track ../<repo>-<task> -b <branch> origin/main`); re-run both selftests per the hooks' own change discipline (`guard-*.selftest.sh`); grep for any selftest case pinning the OLD remediation string and update it as part of the same change. Governed surface (`.claude/**`) ⇒ draft PR, human merge.

Sibling: the objectui twin is filed in that repo (same class, measured `:57`/`:544` there by the #6976 dev). Refs: ui PR #6976 (where the gap was first named) · ui#6880 / #13052 (the `--no-track` adjudications) · ui#6208 (the unfetched-main adjudication).
